First time on this ride? Here’s the drill
Bring
a helmet, front and rear lights (it’s a dark-hours ride), water, a spare tube or patch kit, a way to pay for the stop.
Arrive
Ten or fifteen minutes before the meet time. Tell whoever’s leading that you’re new.
Pace
Slow group ride; no leader.
Check
Look at their Facebook page the day of — that’s where cancellations, weather calls and start changes get posted.

About the Massa Crítica Barcelona group ride

Massa Crítica Barcelona is a Critical Mass ride in Barcelona, Spain. It rolls first Friday of the month at 8:00 pm local time from Arc de Triomf (Passeig Sant Joan).

Barcelona’s monthly Critical Mass, ‘bike every day, celebrate once a month’. Riders meet under the Arc de Triomf and leave about half an hour later.
